11:135.en: 「I'm a combat asset too, you know.」

11:189.en: 「This isn't so bad for a change.」

11:280.en: 「I can't afford to lose this one.」

11:485.en: 「Now I have a reason to fight.」

11:584.en: 「To think I'd fight scum like them...」

11:670.en: 「One demon king is more than enough.」

11:697.en: 「$$ルルーシュ$$ will nag me if you escape...」

11:738.en: 「I may not look it, but I keep score.」

11:900.en: 「I'm not one to forget a favor.」

11:1074.en: 「Heh. Good to have you on my side.」

11:1163.en: 「I said I'd protect you, didn't I?」

11:1192.en: 「Our pact? I'd stay at your side...」

11:1315.en: 「Yes. You can leave it to me.」

11:1367.en: 「I can do at least that much.」

11:1442.en: 「To think I'd run out of energy.」

11:1544.en: 「I won't land in some stupid crisis.」

11:1688.en: 「You've got a long way to go, boy.」

11:1769.en: 「What, you only managed to hit me?」

11:1856.en: 「Shall I praise you for doing well?」

11:1951.en: 「I can't say I'm impressed by this.」

11:2166.en: 「You're as mean as someone I know...」

11:2265.en: 「No way to treat a lady, boy.」

11:2726.en: 「Then I'll show you my trump card...」

11:2934.en: 「Slack off and I'll hear about it...」

11:3009.en: 「Get me a little fired up, will you?」

11:3057.en: 「There's this way of doing it too...!」

11:3215.en: 「Don't get hit in some weird spot.」

11:3396.en: 「As I thought, masked types\nare never any good.」

11:3654.en: 「Let's see if you've grown at all.」

11:3741.en: 「Too many of you. I'm sick of it.」

11:3863.en: 「You seem to have your own purpose.」

11:3917.en: 「I guess I have to stop that unit...」

11:4012.en: 「Me, made to fight an ace. Imagine.」

11:4086.en: 「Don't think you can stay\nso high and mighty forever.」

11:4252.en: 「Long trip. Well done, $$サイデリアル$$.」

11:4453.en: 「Why not act like an emissary of God?」

11:4535.en: 「I never did like\nthat self-righteousness of yours.」

11:4586.en: 「In the end, you're just losers\nwho wagged tails for the strong.」

11:4670.en: 「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.\nI'm sick of your face too.」

11:4719.en: 「Neither of us seems able to die.」

11:4756.en: 「I came all this way.\nI'll give it everything.」

11:4805.en: 「I've seen it...\nThe moment human will forges fate!」

11:4868.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$...!\nI have no intention of pleasing you!」

11:4982.en: 「I'll use all of this thing's power.」

11:5005.en: 「Come on, do me a favor and hit...」

11:5059.en: 「Now then, much as I hate to part...」

11:5161.en: 「Don't be shy. Take my attack too.」

11:5264.en: 「Do I look the type to let it slide?」

11:5295.en: 「You knew it'd come to this, right?」

11:5569.en: 「I just need to pin them down, right?」

11:5675.en: 「You don't seem to know any manners.」

11:5781.en: 「You won't hit me in a hundred years.」

11:5841.en: 「Why not cool your head a little?」

11:5969.en: 「Looks like the unit has no problems.」

11:5996.en: 「Even if it hits, this is nothing.」

11:6056.en: 「Hey, why not put in a little effort?」

11:6128.en: 「Oh? You've risen a bit in my eyes.」

11:6211.en: 「Not good. They have the upper hand.」

11:6281.en: 「Once I'm on the battlefield,\nI'm ready for what comes.」

11:6429.en: 「Why not unmask for the interlude, $$ルルーシュ$$?」

11:6482.en: 「Try resting next to a masked man. Impossible.」

11:6555.en: 「Then just greet them with a smile.」

11:6592.en: 「You trust others now. I can relax.」
